title: Bandon Public Transport Accessibility Analysis

stages.name: Study area & network
stages.description: Define the analytical geography and transport-network frame.

stages.name: Stops & routes
stages.description: Identify principal public transport stops and scheduled service evidence.

stages.name: Vulnerability
stages.description: Integrate Census 2022 indicators describing potential mobility dependence.

stages.name: Composite accessibility
stages.description: Combine walking access and service availability into relative accessibility tiers.

stages.name: Equity screening
stages.description: Examine access deficits alongside population vulnerability.

interpretation: Composite and hotspot outputs are spatial screening evidence and should be validated locally.
